description:
Download Eupruskan Oath v1.4.e

This mod uses pictures made by AI but edited by myself for portraits, one of the hullmods and the market illustrations.

Requires LazyLib and MagicLib

Requires a

new save

to be used and cannot be removed from a save.

Updates are save compatible

but

not with changes to the home system

. Those changes won't show up unless a new game is started.

Features

Adds a new faction, hostile to most vanilla factionsAdds a handful of new ships with no shields (some normal, some with modular armor), see imageAdds a system south of the Core Worlds controlled by the factionAdds a bounty using MagicLib

Ships

Eupruskan Oath ships have no shields but have a tremendous amount of armor for their size. With big weapon slots, fast speed and high armor, they're dangerous foes. Their lack of shielding makes them very vulnerable for EMP and torpedoes, though.

Spoiler

[close]

Hullmod

Spoiler

Cast Armor

The Eupruskan Oath ships have a built in hullmod called "Cast Armor" to increase their armor value even further and get a 100% corona resistance like the s-modded "Solar Shielding".

Tekno-Splice

To avoid losing pilots with a small population at hand, the Oath has designed a system to interlink human flesh with a ship framework. It results in a skeleton crew requirement of 1, at the cost of maximum CR.

[close]
